title: 真实教材树章节知识抽取初测
input_scope: Hello 算法 第7章7.1–7.6文字正文（含原文小结Q&A、公式和表格），不含图像、代码或练习
retry_policy: One harness upload attempt per format; no automatic rerun. Keep the unmodified model client and OpenAI SDK default of at most 2 retries per request for eligible transient errors. These SDK retries are included in upload timing; no business model parameters are changed.
database_isolation: One fresh Neo4j 5.26.0 container and named volume per run; initial node count must be zero
node_scope: Named concepts and operations explained in the supplied text; excludes instance numbers, person names and unelaborated variable names
prediction_stage: Unedited product course graph after the upload attempt. If enrichment fails, score retained graph as PARTIAL, not a successful completed extraction.
primary_matching: Locked reference names/aliases only; Unicode NFKC + casefold + whitespace removal, one-to-one. Duplicates count as unmatched predictions. No fuzzy matching.
relations: CONTAINS and PREREQUISITE_OF directed; RELATED_TO symmetric. Relation type and mapped endpoints must both match. No inferred transitive closure.
metrics: Node and edge TP FP FN precision recall F1; edge metrics by type; duplicates and missing items retained. Unmatched reference != demonstrated factual error.
timing: Wall-clock from HTTP upload dispatch to response; includes parsing, embedding, extraction, DB operations and content enrichment; excludes service/model startup. Also sample server job stages once per second.
threshold_interpretation: 70% contest accuracy is not formally defined; report each metric separately. AI-assisted scores cannot certify the required human-sampled 70% threshold.

source_review_sampling.method: Uniform without replacement over stable sorted predictions, independent AI check against source; human confirmation remains pending

human_review: The report and itemized evidence form a reviewable draft; no claim of human annotation or formal acceptance.
comparison_limit: One independent run per format; generation variation and parser differences are confounded, not a controlled causal estimate of format effects.
